backpack.title: My Backpack
backpack.privacy: Only you can see what's in your Backpack. It's never shown to anyone else on Arriv.
backpack.empty: Your Backpack is empty. Pack your passport, visa grant letter or police check so they're with you when you need them.

folder.deleteBody: It's empty, so nothing else is removed.
folder.notEmpty: Move or delete the files in this folder first.
folder.defaultHint: Default folders can be renamed but not deleted.
folder.limit: You've reached the limit of 30 folders.

upload.title: Pack a document
upload.hint: PDF, Word document or photo, up to 20 MB. Photos have their location data removed.
upload.privateNote: Saved privately. Only you can see it.
upload.cameraDenied: Arriv needs camera access to photograph a document. You can allow it in your phone's Settings.

problem.type: That file type can't go in the Backpack. Use a PDF, Word document or photo.

document.privacy: Only you can see this file.
document.send: Send a copy to a chat
document.deleteBody: It will be removed from your Backpack for good. Copies you've sent to chats stay in those chats.
document.previewError: The preview couldn't load. Try Open.

send.title: Pick a chat
send.body: A copy of “{{name}}” goes to the chat. The original stays private in your Backpack.
send.confirmBody: This file will be visible to everyone in this chat. Only a copy is sent; the original stays in your Backpack.
send.noChats: You don't have any chats yet.

picker.title: Send a document
picker.body: Pick a document. A copy is sent; the original stays private.
picker.empty: Your Backpack is empty. Pack documents from the Backpack tab.

notice.customsBody: This chat is shared experience, not immigration advice. For advice, talk to a registered migration agent or lawyer.

welcome.title: Your journey in Australia.
welcome.body: Meet people on the same visa path, ask questions and keep your documents safe in one place.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.noAccount: New to Arriv? Get your boarding pass

signUp.title: Get your boarding pass
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.terms: Arriv connects people. It does not give immigration advice.

fields.name: Your name
fields.nameHint: This is how people will see you.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to finish signing up.

callback.failed: That link didn't work. It may have expired. Please sign in again.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.alreadyRegistered: There's already an account with this email. Try signing in.
errors.notConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Arriv. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

origin.title: Where are you flying from?
origin.body: Your home country. It shows on your boarding pass.

arrival.title: When did you land?
arrival.body: The day you arrived in Australia to live. We use it to count your days here.
arrival.label: Arrival date

visa.title: What visa are you on?
visa.body: Optional. It helps you find people on the same path. You choose who can see it.
visa.label: Or describe it

city.title: Where are you based?
city.body: Pick your city. You can change it later.

crews.title: Join your first crews
crews.body: People in the same city, on the same visa or speaking your language. Join as many as you like.
crews.empty: No suggestions yet. You can find crews later on the Departures board.

visibility.publicDesc: Anyone on Arriv can see it.

home.journeyA11y: My Journey: your stamps and reminders

tabsPlaceholder.chatBody: Direct messages and community chats. Coming soon.

profile.blockBody: They won't be able to see your profile or contact you, and any connection between you is removed. They aren't told.
profile.removeBody: You'll stop being connected. You can send a new request later.
profile.notFoundBody: The account may not exist, or you can't view it.

errors.handleTaken: That handle is taken. Try another.
errors.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future.

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: No connections yet. Find people in your communities soon.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyNote: Your Backpack, notes and visa expiry are only ever visible to you.

communities.title: Departures
communities.empty: No crews match. Why not start one?
communities.emptyVisa: Add your visa subclass to your profile to see visa crews.
communities.noPosts: No postcards yet. Be the first to write one.
communities.leaveBody: You'll stop seeing its postcards in your feed. You can join again any time.

name.title: What's your crew called?
name.body: Pick a name people will recognise on the departures board.
name.label: Crew name
name.hint: 3–40 characters. You can't change the link later, but you can rename it.

kind.title: What brings the crew together?
kind.body: This helps the right people find it.
kind.city: People living in the same city or town.
kind.visa: People on the same visa path.
kind.language: People who speak the same language.
kind.culture: People who share a culture or home country.
kind.interest: A hobby, a job, a stage of life.

details.cityBody: It becomes the crew's gate on the departures board.
details.visaBody: The 3-digit subclass, like 500 or 482. People on that visa will see your crew suggested.
details.languageBody: People who speak it will see your crew suggested.
details.placeBody: Pick a city, or keep it Australia-wide.
details.gateHint: Optional. Leave it Australia-wide if anyone can join from anywhere.

about.title: Tell people what it's about
about.body: A short welcome helps people decide to board.
about.label: Description
about.hint: Up to 500 characters. You can edit this later.

examples.city: For example: "New in town? Ask about suburbs, rentals and first jobs."
examples.visa: For example: "Share your experience with renewals, work hours and study."
examples.language: For example: "Un espacio para ayudarnos en Australia."
examples.culture: For example: "Celebrate home, share recipes and meet up."
examples.interest: For example: "Weekend rides around the city. All levels welcome."

stamp.title: Design your stamp
stamp.body: Choose a colour. This is how your crew will look.

create.note: Crews are for sharing experience, not giving immigration advice.

feed.question: Question
feed.empty: Your feed is quiet. Join a crew or connect with people to see their postcards here.
feed.deleteBody: It will be removed for everyone.
feed.removeTitle: Remove this postcard from the crew?

compose.title: Send a postcard
compose.bodyPlaceholder: Share an experience or ask the crew…
compose.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to ask?
compose.photosHint: Up to 4. Location data is removed.
compose.notice: Share your own experience. For official information, check Home Affairs.
compose.noCrews: Join a crew to post there, or post to your profile.

errors.photos: Couldn't add those photos. Try again.

compose.noStamps: Add a stamp to your Journey first. Only things that have happened can be shared.
compose.stampHint: Shares the stamp only. Notes and documents stay private.

post.title: Postcard
post.noComments: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
post.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or you can't view it.

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: No chats yet. Message someone from their profile, or open a community chat.
chat.notFoundBody: This chat doesn't exist, or you're not in it any more.
chat.startOfChat: This is the start of your chat.

composer.label: Message
composer.addFile: Attach a PDF or Word file
composer.blocked: You can't send messages in this chat.

attachment.type: Only photos, PDFs and Word documents can be sent.
attachment.imageTooBig: Photos can be up to 10 MB.
attachment.fileTooBig: Files can be up to 20 MB.
attachment.shareWarning: This file will be visible to everyone in this chat.

actions.title: Message
actions.deleteBody: It will disappear for everyone in this chat.

new.title: New chat
new.noResults: No one found. Try another name or handle.
new.noConnections: Connect with people from their profile, or search for them above.
new.inviteHint: People you add get an invite. They join when they accept.
new.needPeople: Pick at least one person to invite.

settings.title: Chat details
settings.invitedNone: Everyone you picked is already here or invited.
settings.muteHint: You won't get notifications or unread counts for it.
settings.leaveBody: You'll stop getting its messages. Someone in the group can invite you back.
settings.leaveOwnerBody: You'll stop getting its messages. The person who's been in the group longest becomes the owner.
settings.communityHint: Leave the community to leave its chat.

emptyFiltered.direct: No direct messages yet. Message someone from their profile, or tap New chat.
emptyFiltered.group: No group chats yet. Tap New chat to start one.
emptyFiltered.community: No community chats yet. Join a community to get its chat room.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.intro: Your milestones in Australia, stamped in your passport.
journey.empty: No stamps yet. Add the day you landed, your visa grant or your first job.
journey.upcomingEmpty: Nothing coming up. Add things like your visa expiry and get a reminder.

form.title: Title
form.remindHint: You'll get a notification at 9am on this day.
form.placeHint: Up to 4 letters, like an airport code.
form.visibilityLabel: Who can see this stamp on your profile?
form.visibilityHint: Coming-up items, notes, reminders and documents are always only for you.

detail.deleteBody: It will be removed from your Journey. Journey updates you've shared keep the stamp.
detail.shareHint: Shares the stamp only. Your notes and documents stay private.
detail.documentsHint: Only you can see these. Linking doesn't share them.
detail.pushOff: Notifications are off, so this reminder can't reach you. Turn them on for Arriv in your phone's Settings.
detail.pushUnavailable: Reminders arrive as notifications in the Arriv app on your phone.

link.title: Link a document
link.body: Pick documents that go with this milestone, like a grant letter. Linking doesn't share them with anyone.
link.empty: Your Backpack is empty. Pack documents from the Backpack tab first.

errors.dateFuture: That date is in the future. Choose "Coming up" instead.
errors.remindAfterDue: The reminder must be on or before the due date.
errors.remindPast: Pick today or a later day.
errors.place: Use up to 4 letters or numbers, like SYD.

kind.title: What are you stamping?
kind.body: Pick the kind of milestone. It sets the style of the stamp.
kind.visa: A visa granted, applied for or expiring
kind.arrival: Landing in Australia or in a new city
kind.work: A new job or new work rights
kind.home: A lease, a move or a first home

when.title: Has it happened yet?
when.body: Stamps are for things that happened. Coming-up items, like a visa expiry, can remind you.
when.doneHint: It becomes a stamp in your passport.
when.upcomingHint: Keep track of it and get a reminder.

details.title: Name your stamp
details.body: A short title, plus a couple of details for the stamp.

remind.title: Want a reminder?
remind.body: Pick a day and you'll get a notification at 9am. You can skip this.

visibility.title: Who can see this stamp?
visibility.body: It shows on your profile and your Journey page. Notes, reminders and documents always stay private.

notes.title: Any private notes?
notes.body: Case numbers, what to do next… Only you can see these. You can skip this.

journey.theirEmpty: No stamps to show. {{name}} may keep their Journey private.
journey.theirNote: You see the stamps {{name}} shares with you. Notes, documents and coming-up items are always private.

report.note: Arriv's admins review every report. The person isn't told who reported them.
report.messageNote: Arriv's admins will see this message to review it. The person isn't told who reported them.
report.thanksBody: An admin will review it. If someone is bothering you, you can also block them from their profile.

admin.title: Reports
admin.removeBody: It disappears for everyone, and all open reports about it are closed.
admin.removeCommunityBody: The community, its posts and its chat are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.
admin.profileNote: To suspend this person, ban them in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users). Then dismiss or close the report here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new yet. Comments, likes, connection requests and Journey reminders show up here.

push.title: Push notifications
push.intro: Choose what Arriv sends to your phone. Everything still appears in your notifications list. To silence one chat, mute it in the chat's details.
push.off: Notifications are off for Arriv on this phone. Turn them on in your phone's Settings to get these.
push.unavailable: Push notifications arrive in the Arriv app on your phone.

messages.label: Messages
messages.hint: Direct and group chats. Community chats never send pushes.

community_joins.label: New crew members
community_joins.hint: When someone joins a crew you own.

reminders.label: Journey reminders
reminders.hint: At 9am on the day you picked.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: This can't be undone. Deleting your account removes:
removes: Your profile, posts, comments and likes
Your own chat messages and the files you sent
Your Backpack and every document in it
deleteAccount.stays: Group chats you were in stay for the other people, and communities you hand over stay too.
deleteAccount.ownedBody: Before you go, hand each one to another member or delete it.
deleteAccount.handOverEmpty: Nobody else is in this community yet. You can delete it instead.
deleteAccount.handOverConfirmBody: They become the owner. You stay on as a moderator until your account is deleted.
deleteAccount.deleteCommunityBody: Its posts and chat room are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.finalBody: Your files and data are removed straight away. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.ownsError: You still own a community. Hand it over or delete it first.
